adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Groot and Mantis are aboard the Benatar with the Guardians when they pull Thor from the wreckage of the Asgardian ship. The team then splits, and Groot leaves with Rocket and Thor while Mantis heads to Knowhere.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate on the Benatar who heads to Knowhere as Groot leaves with Thor.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate on the Benatar who leaves with Rocket and Thor.
adds.evidence: Mantis announces they are arriving at the distress signal while Groot plays his game aboard the Benatar; after rescuing Thor, Thor leaves with Rocket and Groot while Quill, Gamora, Drax and Mantis go to Knowhere.
